correctness.rationale: An irredundant odd-cycle H-description follows by removing the unique half-integral vertex from the edge relaxation; the hole facet is a simplex by a nonzero circulant determinant. Exact codimension-two face witnesses and third-facet obstructions exhaust all possible facet pairs. The two nonzero normal cosines are 1/2 and sqrt(2/n), giving the exact angle census, n=5 exception, and n=9 order crossover. A standard-library exhaustive checker with exact rational ranks passed orders 4 through 13; finite results corroborate but do not prove the quantified theorem.

value.rationale: The complete dihedral multiset is a natural metric invariant of the extensively studied stable-set polytopes of odd holes. It distinguishes two geometrically different classes of obtuse ridges, establishes an exceptional pentagon deficit, and proves a sharp crossover at n=9 and a rare-angle mixture law. The metric result requires a nontrivial full facet-adjacency classification; neither correctness nor numeric reproducibility alone is used as a substitute for this structural motivation.
